start.rule_time: The time spent on each question is tracked: answering too fast may look suspicious, and too slow may indicate technical difficulty.
start.rule_focus: Every time the window loses focus is counted. There is an acceptable limit, but frequent exits may signal external help.
start.rule_open_close: Every time the test is opened and closed is logged, to prevent questions from being reviewed in advance and creating an unfair advantage.
start.rule_consistency: Answer consistency is evaluated: getting hard questions right while missing easy ones is not advantageous.
start.score_warning: Be aware that all of these factors can affect your final score!

soft_skills.communication_description: Ability to clearly express ideas and understand others in verbal and written communication.
soft_skills.teamwork_description: Ability to collaborate effectively with others to achieve shared goals.
soft_skills.problem_solving_description: Ability to analyze situations and develop effective solutions.
soft_skills.adaptability_description: Ability to adjust to new situations, challenges, and changing environments.
soft_skills.time_management_description: Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time efficiently to meet deadlines.
soft_skills.critical_thinking_description: Ability to evaluate information objectively and make reasoned decisions.
soft_skills.leadership_description: Ability to guide, motivate, and support a team towards achieving goals.
soft_skills.conflict_resolution_description: Ability to manage and resolve disagreements in a constructive way.
soft_skills.emotional_intelligence_description: Ability to recognize, understand, and manage your own emotions and those of others.
soft_skills.accountability_description: Ability to take responsibility for actions, decisions, and their outcomes.

soft_skill_level_responses.communication_very_poor_description: Struggles to express ideas clearly and often causes misunderstandings within the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.communication_basic_description: Communicates simple ideas but lacks clarity in more complex discussions.
soft_skill_level_responses.communication_intermediate_description: Communicates clearly in most situations and participates in team discussions.
soft_skill_level_responses.communication_advanced_description: Expresses ideas clearly and ensures team alignment during discussions.
soft_skill_level_responses.communication_expert_description: Communicates complex ideas effectively and facilitates productive discussions.
soft_skill_level_responses.teamwork_very_poor_description: Rarely collaborates and often works in isolation from the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.teamwork_basic_description: Occasionally collaborates but has difficulty aligning with the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.teamwork_intermediate_description: Works well with teammates and contributes to shared goals.
soft_skill_level_responses.teamwork_advanced_description: Actively collaborates and helps improve team productivity.
soft_skill_level_responses.teamwork_expert_description: Promotes strong collaboration and strengthens team dynamics.
soft_skill_level_responses.problem_solving_very_poor_description: Has difficulty identifying problems or proposing solutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.problem_solving_basic_description: Can solve simple problems but struggles with complex situations.
soft_skill_level_responses.problem_solving_intermediate_description: Analyzes problems and proposes reasonable solutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.problem_solving_advanced_description: Breaks down complex problems and consistently finds effective solutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.problem_solving_expert_description: Anticipates problems and designs strategic solutions for complex challenges.
soft_skill_level_responses.adaptability_very_poor_description: Has significant difficulty adapting to changes in processes, technologies, or team dynamics.
soft_skill_level_responses.adaptability_basic_description: Shows some resistance to change but can adapt with guidance and additional time.
soft_skill_level_responses.adaptability_intermediate_description: Adapts to new tools, environments, and processes with moderate support.
soft_skill_level_responses.adaptability_advanced_description: Quickly adapts to new situations, technologies, and project requirements.
soft_skill_level_responses.adaptability_expert_description: Proactively embraces change and helps the team adapt effectively to new challenges.
soft_skill_level_responses.time_management_very_poor_description: Struggles to organize tasks and frequently misses deadlines.
soft_skill_level_responses.time_management_basic_description: Completes tasks but has difficulty prioritizing work and managing deadlines.
soft_skill_level_responses.time_management_intermediate_description: Manages time reasonably well and usually delivers tasks within expected deadlines.
soft_skill_level_responses.time_management_advanced_description: Effectively prioritizes work and consistently meets deadlines even under pressure.
soft_skill_level_responses.time_management_expert_description: Demonstrates exceptional organization and helps the team optimize time and productivity.
soft_skill_level_responses.critical_thinking_very_poor_description: Has difficulty analyzing information and often relies on assumptions.
soft_skill_level_responses.critical_thinking_basic_description: Can analyze simple situations but struggles with complex reasoning.
soft_skill_level_responses.critical_thinking_intermediate_descripti: Evaluates information logically and contributes to problem discussions.
soft_skill_level_responses.critical_thinking_advanced_description: Consistently analyzes situations critically and proposes well-reasoned solutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.critical_thinking_expert_description: Demonstrates exceptional analytical thinking and guides others in making sound decisions.
soft_skill_level_responses.leadership_very_poor_description: Avoids responsibility for guiding others and struggles to provide direction or support to the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.leadership_basic_description: Occasionally provides guidance but lacks consistency in motivating or supporting the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.leadership_intermediate_description: Supports teammates and helps coordinate efforts to achieve team objectives.
soft_skill_level_responses.leadership_advanced_description: Actively motivates and guides the team while helping resolve challenges and maintain alignment.
soft_skill_level_responses.leadership_expert_description: Demonstrates strong leadership by inspiring others, guiding decisions, and fostering team growth.
soft_skill_level_responses.conflict_resolution_very_poor_descriptio: Avoids or escalates conflicts and struggles to contribute to constructive resolutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.conflict_resolution_basic_description: Recognizes conflicts but has difficulty facilitating productive discussions to resolve them.
soft_skill_level_responses.conflict_resolution_intermediate_descrip: Participates in resolving disagreements and helps maintain respectful communication.
soft_skill_level_responses.conflict_resolution_advanced_description: Effectively mediates conflicts and helps guide discussions toward constructive outcomes.
soft_skill_level_responses.conflict_resolution_expert_description: Proactively identifies potential conflicts and facilitates collaborative and sustainable solutions.
soft_skill_level_responses.emotional_intelligence_very_poor_descrip: Struggles to recognize emotions in self or others and may react impulsively in challenging situations.
soft_skill_level_responses.emotional_intelligence_basic_description: Shows some awareness of emotions but has difficulty managing reactions consistently.
soft_skill_level_responses.emotional_intelligence_intermediate_desc: Recognizes emotional dynamics and generally responds in a respectful and balanced manner.
soft_skill_level_responses.emotional_intelligence_advanced_descript: Demonstrates strong emotional awareness and maintains constructive interactions even in stressful situations.
soft_skill_level_responses.emotional_intelligence_expert_descriptio: Exhibits exceptional emotional intelligence and positively influences the emotional dynamics of the team.
soft_skill_level_responses.accountability_very_poor_description: Avoids responsibility for outcomes and frequently shifts blame to others.
soft_skill_level_responses.accountability_basic_description: Accepts responsibility when prompted but may struggle to consistently follow through on commitments.
soft_skill_level_responses.accountability_intermediate_description: Takes ownership of tasks and acknowledges responsibility for results.
soft_skill_level_responses.accountability_advanced_description: Consistently demonstrates ownership, reliability, and responsibility for outcomes.
soft_skill_level_responses.accountability_expert_description: Leads by example in accountability and encourages a culture of ownership within the team.
